definitions.gloss: slow and fast; pace variation; modulation
definitions.explanation: the variation between slow and fast speeds or tempos; used in music, speech, and sports
A crisis or emergency. Literary; it survives mainly in the set phrases {一旦|いったん}{緩急|かんきゅう}あれば and {一朝|いっちょう}{緩急|かんきゅう}あれば (should an emergency arise).

examples.japanese: {緩急|かんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
{緩急|かんきゅう}⟦{自在|じざい}→自在：21493_jizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{操|あやつ}る→操る：12707_ayatsuru⟧。
examples.english: To control the ball freely with varying speeds.
examples.notes: 緩急自在 means having complete control over pace variation

examples.japanese: ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{緩急|かんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Adding tempo variation to the performance makes the expression richer.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピッチャー→ピッチャー：09482_picchaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緩急|かんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}けて→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧⟦バッター→バッター：27284_battaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えた→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: The pitcher kept the batter in check by mixing slow and fast pitches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一旦|いったん}→一旦：04099_ittan⟧{緩急|かんきゅう}⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧
{一朝|いっちょう}{緩急|かんきゅう}⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつける→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Should an emergency arise, I will come at once.

examples.japanese: {緩急|かんきゅう}⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}う→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧だ。
examples.english: True friends help each other in times of need.

notes:
Composed of {緩|かん} (slow, relaxed) + ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (fast, urgent). The two senses come from different readings of this contrast: variation in speed (sense 1) versus the urgent end of the spectrum (sense 2).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {緩急|かんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to vary the pace
- {緩急|かんきゅう}⟦{自在|じざい}→自在：21493_jizai⟧: having complete control over pace variation
- {緩急|かんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧: to mix fast and slow skillfully
- ⟦{一旦|いったん}→一旦：04099_ittan⟧{緩急|かんきゅう}⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧: should an emergency arise (literary)

USAGE:
- Music: varying tempo for expressiveness
- Baseball: mixing fast and slow pitches
- Speech/writing: varying rhythm and pacing
- Sense 1 is the everyday one; sense 2 is literary and found almost only in 〜{緩急|かんきゅう}⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧.
